tldr: Pluto through the 2nd house intensifies money, security, values, and self-worth.
body:
When Pluto moves through your 2nd house, it brings pressure to money, security, possessions, self-worth, spending, income, and what helps you feel steady. You may notice what feels worth keeping, what costs too much, and what would help life feel more stable.

Something may no longer stay buried, controlled, avoided, or handled only on the surface. It can help you face the deeper truth and stop spending energy protecting a false version of peace.

The useful side is that this timing can make the next honest move easier to see. This is useful for making a more honest choice around resources, desire, and value.

The caution: Watch for trying to control the outcome so tightly that you cannot tell what is changing naturally. The risk is confusing immediate comfort with real security.

Pluto moves through this house for a long chapter. Work with the deeper truth instead of forcing everything back into the old shape.
